args.subject: Support time zone corrected and missed-SLA credit applied
args.body:
Hi Fabrikam Ltd team,

We've corrected your support time zone to UTC-5 in our system so future support calls are scheduled in your local time zone. We've also applied a 175 missed-SLA credit to your account as compensation for the incident.

Please let us know if you notice any further scheduling issues.

Regards,
Support Operations
